name: Ability Mastery
effect_text: The Pokémon gains an additional Ability, picked from any Ability it could naturally qualify for.

name: Accuracy Training
effect_text: Pick a Move with an AC of 3 or higher; the AC of the target Move is permanently lowered by 1. This Poké Edge may be taken up to three times, each time selecting a different Move.

name: Advanced Connection
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: An Ability with the Connection Keyword
effect_text: Choose an Ability with the Connection Keyword that the target has; the Connected Move no longer takes up a Move Slot for the user.

name: Advanced Mobility
effect_text: Increase one Movement Capability by 2. This Edge may be taken multiple times, but may not be applied more than once to the same Movement Capability.

name: Attack Conflict
effect_text: Select Attack or Special Attack. From now on, that Stat does not need to remain higher than Stats it surpasses in Base Relations, and similarly all other Stats surpassed by it do not need to remain lower.

name: Aura Pulse
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Level 30, Aura Reading, owned by a
effect_text: The Pokémon gains the Aura Pulse Capability.

name: Basic Ranged Attacks
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Level 20, one of Firestarter, Fountain,
effect_text: Choose one of the Capabilities listed in the prerequisites for this Poké Edge. Struggle Attacks modified by that Capability may now be made at a range of up to 6 meters. This Poké Edge may be taken multiple times, selecting a different Capability each time.

name: Capability Training
effect_text: Increase Power or a Jump Capability by 1. Capability Training may be taken multiple times, each time increasing a different Capability.

name: Enticing Bait
effect_text: When activating the Alluring Capability, the user adds the higher of its Athletics or Focus Ranks to its d20 roll.

name: Extended Invisibility
effect_text: The user may remain Invisible for up to 8 minutes.

name: Far Reading
effect_text: The user treats their Focus Rank as 2 higher for the purposes of determining the range of Telepath.

name: Mixed Sweeper
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Level 10, Invested at least 5 Level- | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Level 20, Invested at least 10 | Rank 3 Prerequisites: Level 40, Invested at least 15
effect_text: Each Rank, the user gains 3 Stat Points to distribute freely between HP, Defense, Special Defense, or Speed. These bonus points are treated as if they were "Level Up" points, and do not alter Base Stats.

name: Precise Threadings
effect_text: The user may use their Threaded Capability at a range of 6 meters and with an AC of 3 rather than 6.

name: Realized Potential
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Level 30, User is an Underdog Pokémon
effect_text: Subtract the user's Species Base Stat Total from 45. The user gains Bonus Stat Points equal to the remain- der. These Stat Points must follow Base Stat Relations as normal. If the user evolves to a species with a Base Stat Total 45 or higher, Realized Potential is removed and the Tutor Points refunded.

name: Seismometer
effect_text: The user's Tremorsense range is increased by a number of meters equal to their Perception Rank.

name: Skill Improvement
effect_text: Rank up one Skill that is currently at or below its default level for the species. This Edge may be taken multiple times, each time selecting a different Skill.

name: TK Mastery
effect_text: The user treats their Focus Rank as 2 higher for the purposes of the Telekinetic Capability.

name: Trail Sniffer
effect_text: The user gets a bonus to all Perception Rolls to use the Tracker Capability equal to their Focus Rank.

name: Underdog's Lessons
effect_text: Choose a Level-Up Move from one of the user's Final Evolutions that it can learn at or below its current Level. The user learns that Move as if it were a Level- Up Move and can now learn Moves from TMs, HMs, and Tutoring from the lists of that Final Evolution. Underdog's Lessons may be taken up to three times but must use the same Final Evolution each time in the case of Pokémon with multiple Final Evolutions.

name: Underdog's Strength
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Level 15, User is an Underdog Pokémon
effect_text: The user has each of their Base Stats increased by +1. The user may no longer undergo Evolution.
